title: An unresolved ${} placeholder aborts startup with a non-zero exit
intent: The suite parameterises every case through SFC's own environment substitution, so this behaviour is load-bearing for the whole harness: if an unset placeholder were silently left as a literal, a case could quietly write to a directory named '${SFC_E2E_SINK}' and pass for the wrong reason. ConfigReader.setPlaceholders reports it and ServiceMain calls exitProcess(1). This is also the suite's first negative configuration test - the repo has none.
